Neural speech component notices and corresponding sources

Kokoro-ONNX: MIT; Kokoro model: Apache-2.0. The optional local voice engine uses phonemizer (GPL-3.0) and eSpeak NG 1.52.0 (GPL-3.0-or-later). Their license texts and source archives are included here, along with the loader build script. Python package notices are also in the portable licenses folder. These sources are provided for inspection and rebuilding; model weights are downloaded separately and are not in the portable archive.
